title: Bacon and Leek Tart
blurb: A savoury tart with tender leeks cooked in white wine and crispy bacon pieces, baked in shortcrust pastry.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C and roll out the pastry to line a 23cm tart tin, pricking the base with a fork. Line with baking paper and baking beans, then blind bake for 15 minutes until pale golden.
Meanwhile, trim and slice the leeks into rounds about 1cm thick, washing them well. Cut the bacon into small pieces.
Melt the butter in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the bacon until it starts to crisp. Add the leeks and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble away until mostly evaporated, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper, then remove from the heat.
Whisk together the cream and eggs in a bowl. Remove the beans and paper from the pastry case and reduce the oven to 180°C.
Spread the leek and bacon mixture evenly in the pastry case, then pour over the cream mixture. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the filling is just set with a slight wobble in the centre.
Let the tart cool for 10 minutes in the tin before slicing and serving warm or at room temperature.
